messages:
elena (PM): quick thread 0min: we need a concise acceptance checklist for the long-term routing + multi-region + tenant isolation work. aim: something Sales can point to in early contracts.

 tom (Eng-Arch): proposal: define 3 isolation tiers instead of lanes:
  - strict: per-tenant region pin + no cross-region failover (for regulated customers)
  - flexible: prefer-local with automated regional failover after grace window
  - shared: cost-first, global pool, eventual consistency for residency

 kai (Infra): infra implications: strict requires per-tenant placement metadata + enforced egress controls. that means dedicated placement shards or hard pins in the scheduler. flexible needs fast failover hooks + warm standby. shared benefits most from batching/quantization.

 lina (Sales): from customers: they want a "contract-ready" definition for strict (e.g., region locked, audit trail, retention SLA). they'd also like a migration guarantee for existing tenants (shadow run + 14-day stability).

 elena (PM): good. what are minimal GA acceptance items for each tier? keep it short.

 tom (Eng-Arch): minimal GA:
  - strict: enforcement test for residency (automated), audit logs present, and fail-open disallowed.
  - flexible: measured failover latency (p95), traffic drain procedure, and documented evacuation window.
  - shared: cost measurement (tokens/$) and noisy-neighbor isolation sandbox.

 kai (Infra): tests to run: multi-region traffic replay, tenant eviction simulation, billing tag reconciliation. estimate: 4 sprint work for strict (placement + logs), 2 sprints for flexible ops, 3 sprints for shared optimizations.

 lina (Sales): add to checklist: legal addendum for residency + pricing delta estimate table. customers want a UI toggle in Console to preview cost & latency tradeoffs before signing.

 elena (PM): Console needs: lane preview, per-tenant policy editor, and clear diff of estimated monthly cost. Ops also needs an API for programmatic cutovers.

 tom (Eng-Arch): policy sketch (for Console/API):
  ```
  {
    "tier": "strict|flexible|shared",
    "region_pin": "eu-west-1|us-east-1|null",
    "failover_grace_s": 120,
    "evacuate_on_capacity": "true|false"
  }
  ```

 kai (Infra): implementation note: store policy as a single JSON blob in tenant metadata, but keep derived fields for fast routing decisions. avoid per-request JSON parsing on the hot path.

 legal-bot: reminder: attach residency addendum draft to the contract template repo: /contracts/residency-addendum-v1.md

 lina (Sales): timeline ask: can we offer pilots for Q2? need 2 anchor customers and a short pilot pack (runbook + support SLA).

 elena (PM): tentative roadmap: sprint A: strict infra + logs; sprint B: flexible failover hooks + console editor; sprint C: shared cost optimizations + billing validation. gate GA on: (1) residency enforcement tests passing, (2) two successful pilot cutovers, (3) billing reconciliation within 3% of expected.

 tom (Eng-Arch): agree. also include an escape hatch: allow per-tenant "force-failback" in Console to rollback regional changes within 10m.

 kai (Infra): scheduling note: we'll need reserved capacity for strict tier pilots. I'll sketch a reserved SKU and capacity worksheet.

 elena (PM): action items: tom -> architecture spec + test matrix (EOW). kai -> reserved SKU spreadsheet + infra ETA (Tue). lina -> get 2 pilot commitments + legal contact (Mon). I'll draft GA checklist and pilot pack.

 lina (Sales): ack, will start outreach. :rocket:

 tom (Eng-Arch): one last thing: we should log the migration metrics we care about: cutover latency delta, error budget burn, and per-tenant cost delta. use these to gate GA.

 elena (PM): noted. thanks everyone, will slot follow-up sync on Fri.
